extracted.intended_audience: journalists, reporters and editors at news organisations (e.g., Reuters)
extracted.subtask_description: A newsroom/style-guide checklist and guidance for producing accurate, fair, legally safe and well-written news stories (headlines, sourcing, images, corrections, privacy, sub-editing, etc.). Targets reporters, sub-editors and editors following Reuters standards.
